boxes.observation: DU, a double character space, LANGUEDOC, followed by thirteen separate circumflex marks on a second row.

Double quotation marks enclose the full heading; option is lowercase and has wider spacing on both sides. A distinct decoration row contains sixty equals signs. The uppercase words have no supplied accents.

Underlined word p[composite character]évus. The second character has an r-like left stem and shoulder, an additional sloping upper-right stroke reaching a horizontal top serif, and an additional lower-right upright with a baseline foot. Its overlapping ink is preserved in a direct inline TikZ trace inside the uncertainty marker. No definite deletion span or typing order is assigned.
uncertainties: Component character identity and order of the overlapping impressions are unresolved. The upper-right diagonal/top serif and lower-right upright are retained graphically rather than discarded.

boxes.observation: Parentheses enclose Cedrus atl[composite a-like character]ntica Manetti. Cedrus and the following epithet are underlined; Manetti and the parentheses are not underlined. The a-like slot after atl carries a raised sloping stroke with a short top bar, preserved by an inline TikZ trace. The underline has a gap below the following n.
uncertainties: The raised/sloping mark overlaps the a-shaped body. Its component identity and typing order remain unresolved; no accent or replacement letter has been silently supplied.

boxes.observation: Complete signature traced in TikZ. A tall vertical with an open loop at its top intersects a narrow upper-left loop/cross-stroke, a large left open loop and a long lower flourish. A small inner oval is separate. The rightward tail rises through a closed narrow loop then descends to a detached terminal dot. Two detached marks lie above-left of that terminal, one round and one oblique; a detached left dash and a short detached upper-left vertical segment are also visible.
uncertainties: No reliable complete signature letter sequence is extracted; actual paths are supplied.
Fine continuity near the bottom of the long vertical is weak and is represented as a short path break.
